messages:
matt: Heads-up — planning an online schema swap for orders tomorrow 03:00 UTC. No exclusive table locks, but we'll do a shadow-table swap and 1-shard canary. Pushing migration job: migrate_orders_v7 --swap-only. Please ack if you're on-call or have objections.

db-oncall: Ack. What's the plan for replica lag and throttling? Last time a heavy report job spiked replicas.

matt: Good call. Plan: start canary on shard-3 with throttle 40 qps. Monitor replica_lag metric (replica_lag_seconds). Abort if lag > 20s for >2m. If abort, fallback is to pin app to v1.9 and re-run background backfill during low traffic window.

kevin: Add a preflight that samples 200 rows to ensure index names match. Also include a quick check: SELECT count(*) FROM orders_shadow WHERE created_at IS NULL; to catch ddl edge-case.

emma: I'll own the automation for the throttle. I'll run: 
```
python infra/scripts/run_migration.py --job migrate_orders_v7 --shard shard-3 --throttle 40 --canary
```
I can trigger the canary at 03:00 and promote at +15m if no alerts.

deploy-bot: migration-job started: id=mig-2026-11-03-0310 shard=shard-3 mode=canary (triggered by emma) :rocket:

db-oncall: Monitoring dashboards up. Will watch replica_lag_seconds, replica_io_wait, and pg_stat_activity count. Alert if replica_lag_seconds > 20 for 2m.

release-coordinator: FYI, release notes snippet: "orders: online swap to support variable tax codes; safe canary + controlled throttle; rollback to v1.9 if replica lag observed." I'll drop that into the release doc now.

matt: If canary looks good @15m, we'll promote to other shards with throttle 60 qps and 5m stagger between shards. No full-table locks. Coordinate with traffic team for a short surge window at +45m if we need extra capacity.

sara: One ask — pin the app image for this rollout to avoid any concurrent schema-related PRs landing. I'll lock the deploy pipeline to tag=orders-release-20261103.

kevin: Also, add a post-swap verification: run 10 random queries from app traces and ensure results match old table within 1% SLA. Script: 
```
infra/verify/compare_orders.sh --samples 10 --tolerance 0.01
```

deploy-bot: migration-job status: canary completed on shard-3, checks=passed, job=mig-2026-11-03-0310. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/mig-2026-11-03-0310

emma: Promoting to shard-1 now with throttle=60. Will update here after shard-1 & shard-2 complete.

db-oncall: saw a transient lag spike ~10s during shard-1 promote, resolved automatically. No abort.

matt: Great. If anyone sees unexpected behavior, call pager and roll back the app pin. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
